summaryZh: Meharena 的 DevCoGx 研究组研究人脑发育的分子与细胞基础，以及这些过程受扰后如何导致神经发育和神经系统疾病。团队结合小鼠模型、人多能干细胞及基因组、分子和功能方法，寻找影响神经发育与认知的基因网络及细胞类型特异机制。
researchQuestions: 大脑如何在分子与细胞层面发育以支持认知，这些过程的扰动如何促成神经发育障碍与神经系统疾病？

evidence.quote: Our overarching goal is to build a detailed molecular and cellular map of the developing human brain to identify the gene networks and cell-type–specific mechanisms that shape neurodevelopment and cognition.
To address these questions, we combine mouse models and human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs) with genomic, molecular, and functional approaches.
Developmental and Cognitive Genomics (DevCoGx) Research Group
We are located at the University of California, San Diego School of Biological Sciences, Departments of Neurobiology and Molecular Biology

We seek to understand how the brain develops at the molecular and cellular levels to support cognition, and how disruptions in these processes contribute to neurodevelopmental and neurological disorders.
